title: Automation Engineer
description:
**Shape the Future of Industrial Automation as an Automation Engineer**
=======================================================================

Are you passionate about automation technology and solving complex engineering challenges? Join us as an **Automation Engineer** in Pune, India, where you will work across the full project lifecycle, from system design and software development to factory testing, commissioning, and customer start\-ups. You will collaborate with multidisciplinary teams, contribute to advanced automation solutions for the pulp, paper, and packaging industries, and play a key role in delivering high\-quality projects that move our customers' performance forward. This is an opportunity to grow your expertise while working on impactful projects in India and across global customer sites.


**Your responsibilities**
-------------------------

* You will develop and program automation logic using **Valmet DNA/MCS** application engineering solutions, ensuring systems meet project and customer requirements. \[
* You will partner with Chief Engineers and project teams to plan software engineering scope, align delivery with contract requirements, and support successful project execution.
* You will collaborate with design, development, production, and site teams to achieve delivery milestones, maintain quality standards, and manage project risks.
* You will support pre\-assemblies, Factory Acceptance Testing (FAT), installation, commissioning, I/O checks, functional testing, and start\-up activities at customer sites.
* You will troubleshoot, modify, and optimize software and hardware applications, maintain project documentation, uphold site safety standards, and contribute to customer satisfaction throughout project delivery.

**Expectations for you**
------------------------

* You have a Bachelor's degree in **Instrumentation Engineering** or **Electrical Engineering** .
* You bring **4\-7 years of experience** in industrial automation, preferably within pulp, paper, board, packaging, or related process industries.
* You have hands\-on experience with **PLC/DCS systems** such as Siemens, ABB, Allen\-Bradley, or Valmet DNA, including control logic development, testing, troubleshooting, and project execution.
* You can read and interpret P\&IDs, electrical schematics, control drawings, and understand industrial communication protocols such as Modbus, Profibus, Profinet, Ethernet/IP, and OPC.
* You have strong English communication skills and are willing to travel to customer sites within India and internationally for extended project assignments.

**We offer**
------------

You will join the **PAC Machines AE India Engineering** team, working closely with multidisciplinary engineering professionals on automation projects for the pulp, paper, and packaging industries. The team is involved throughout the project lifecycle, covering system design, software development, testing, commissioning, customer start\-ups, quality assurance, risk management, and project delivery. You will have the opportunity to collaborate with experts across functions and geographies while building deep technical expertise in advanced industrial automation solutions. The role offers exposure to customer\-facing projects, international teamwork, and challenging engineering assignments that support operational excellence and customer success.


Valmet offers an inspiring and challenging position with excellent opportunities for professional and personal development. You will work in an international and collaborative environment, supported by modern tools, continuous learning opportunities, and a culture that values expertise, innovation, and teamwork.


**Want to know more?**
----------------------

Did we catch your interest? If you are ready to take the next step in your automation engineering career, we would love to hear from you.


Please submit your application and CV through the application link no later than **October 10, 2026** . To learn more about Valmet, visit **www.valmet.com** .


**When everything works together**
----------------------------------

*Valmet is where the best talent from a wide variety of backgrounds comes together. We work together with our customers throughout the entire lifecycle, delivering cutting\-edge technologies and services as well as mission\-critical automation and flow control solutions. Backed by more than 225 years of industrial experience and a global team of over 19,000 professionals close to customers, we are uniquely positioned to transform industries toward a regenerative tomorrow.*

*At Valmet, diversity of thought drives innovation. We are committed to a respectful and inclusive environment, where people can be themselves and are supported to contribute at their best. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds and make hiring decisions based on skills, experience, and potential, never on personal characteristics such as gender, gender identity, age, ethnicity, nationality, disability, neurodiversity, religion, sexual orientation, or political views.*

*Join the team – and lead the way with us!*  

*www.valmet.com/careers*

title: Automation Engineer II (PLC/DCS/SCADA)
description:
**Bring more to life.**
-----------------------

  

Are you ready to accelerate your potential and make a real difference within life sciences, diagnostics and biotechnology?

  

At Cytiva, one of Danaher’s 15\+ operating companies, our work saves lives—and we’re all united by a shared commitment to innovate for tangible impact.

  

You’ll thrive in a culture of belonging where you and your unique viewpoint matter. And by harnessing Danaher’s system of continuous improvement, you help turn ideas into impact – innovating at the speed of life.

  

Working at Cytiva means being at the forefront of providing new solutions to transform human health. Our incredible customers undertake life\-saving activities ranging from fundamental biological research to developing innovative vaccines, new medicines, and cell and gene therapies.

  

At Cytiva you will be able to continuously improve yourself and us – working on challenges that truly matter with people that care for each other, our customers, and their patients. Take your next step to an altogether life\-changing career.

  

Learn about the Danaher Business System which makes everything possible.

  

The **Automation Engineer II** is part of the Custom Engineering organization located in **Pune** and will be an on\-site role. At Cytiva, our vision is, to advance future therapeutics from discovery to delivery.

 **What you’ll do**

* Understand customer requirements, P\&IDs, URS, required international standards compliances and accordingly Design, develop, configure, test, and commission automation solutions for Cytiva bioprocess systems (chromatography, filtration, TFF, single\-use mixers etc.) that combine UNICORN system control software with Rockwell Automation PLC hardware and programming environments, in compliance with GAMP 5, 21 CFR Part 11, and S88 standards.
* Have ability or readiness to learn to write/analyze technical proposals and costing. Utilize Instrumentation and automation detailed design engineering, Instrument Configuration and Calibration, prepare project schedules, loop diagrams, Instrument Index, cable schedules, Instrument Hookup drawings, Automation architecture, component selection, Control panel specifications, IO List preparation, Wiring Drawing verification, GA verification, etc.
* Collaborate cross\-functionally with suppliers, end users, project managers and other engineers to achieve elegant solutions. Perform testing, commissioning, and complete execution of all Instrumentation and Automation components in their project meeting or exceeding customer expectations. Providing training to users.
* Perform UNICORN (Cytiva product) Configuration \& Method Development; Rockwell PLC Development, Produce the Rockwell/UNICORN documentation set. Perform PLC/DCS/SCADA Automation Software testing, be able to debug and optimize code, write efficient coding as per best practices and have very good hand\-on experience on Siemens platform. Should know about GAMP 5 and ERES compliance requirements. Should support product life cycle management and understand product obsolescence. Well versed with ISA and IEC standards, wiring rules and other standards.  

Should be a good problem Solver.

 **Who you are**

* BE Instrumentation/Electrical/E\& TC/Computer Science or equivalent. A higher degree or secondary degree in a related subject would be an advantage. Experience of project engineering / project management of equipment used in Biopharmaceutical manufacturing with relevant experience and knowledge to perform commissioning support on a filtration, separation, and purification system/equipment in the biopharmaceutical industry.
* A minimum of 6\+ years post qualification experience in Automation or similar position. Experience within the biopharmaceutical market is added advantage. Factory test work and/or site work experience.

 **Travel Requirements:**

* Willing to travel up to 25% of time for project follow up, inspection, SAT, troubleshooting at customer site.

  

Join our winning team today. Together, we’ll accelerate the real\-life impact of tomorrow’s science and technology. We partner with customers across the globe to help them solve their most complex challenges, architecting solutions that bring the power of science to life.


For more information, visit www.danaher.com.

title: Automation Engineer
description:
At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.



This Position reports to:



Regional Customer Support Manager \#\#\#


**Your role and responsibilities**



In this role, you will have the opportunity to act as a design authority for an engineering discipline with low to medium complexity. Each day, you will complete assignments on small projects or portions of larger projects in a cost\-effective manner. You will also showcase your skills by applying basic design thinking/design best practices concepts in projects.



The work model for the role is: \#LI \- Onsite



This role is contributing to the machine automation within ABB's Automation division in Pune/Ahmedabad\-India region. Main stakeholders include Customers, Application Engineers, Sales Teams, Engineering Teams, Global Product Support/HQ Teams, Training Participants, Project Teams, and OEM/Manufacturing Customers.


**You will be mainly accountable for:**


* Providing pre\-sales and post\-sales technical support to customers and application engineers, resolving product, software, and application\-related issues through remote support channels.
* Identifying and diagnosing automation system challenges, delivering timely solutions to ensure optimal system performance and customer satisfaction.
* Building and maintaining positive customer relationships by facilitating effective communication and coordinating with internal and external stakeholders.
* Planning and executing technical support activities, including issue escalation, problem resolution, and collaboration with global teams to implement innovative solutions and best practices.
* Developing skills in automation products and real\-time software applications while supporting knowledge sharing, continuous improvement, and technical excellence.
* Delivering technical training and application engineering support, including software development, commissioning, documentation, and reporting of technical activities


**Qualifications for the role:**


* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering (Electrical, Electronics, Electrical \& Electronics, Mechatronics, Instrumentation, or a related discipline).
* 1\-5 years of experience in application development, commissioning, and technical support within industrial automation environments, with experience in multinational organizations.
* Solid knowledge of Industrial Automation systems, including PLCs, HMIs, Servo Drives, Motion Control, Motors, Robotics, and integrated machine automation solutions.
* Practical experience in application engineering, problem solving, customer support, commissioning, and deployment of automation solutions.
* Good understanding of control theory, structured programming, and software development practices, with proficiency in C/ST programming preferred.
* Knowledge of electronics, mechanics, and applied mathematics, with experience supporting industries such as Food \& Beverage (F\&B), CPG, and Consumer Goods.
* Excellent communication, customer engagement, and training skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively in cross\-functional and customer\-focused environments.


**More about us:**



B\&R Industrial Automation is a manufacturer of automation technology and ABB's global center for machine and factory automation. B\&R was founded in 1979 by Erwin Bernecker and Josef Rainer and has its headquarters in Eggelsberg, Upper Austria. Today, B\&R is a leading global solution provider for automating machines and factories and is responsible for machine automation in ABB's Robotics \& Discrete Automation division.



Building a cleaner, smarter future takes all kinds of minds: the curious, the courageous, and the creative. We welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences.
